On occasional Sundays, I also have a series where I introduce you to some of the Newsletters on that epic list. It’s called Good Reads in A.I. and the format is for weekend reading. 

In case you are new around here I’m also working on lists of influencers in A.I. to get the best out of feeds for A.I. news. 

Better Access to A.I. News and Coverage 

But it’s not all about Newsletters that’s for sure. How can we optimize feeds like X or LinkedIn? It’s all about the super-follow. 

In the spirit of utility and trying to give my readers some grounded options to empower their ability to have the best access to breaking news in the A.I. space, I’ve prepared some lists of who to follow on LinkedIn, X (formerly Twitter) and so forth. 

I have started a list for who to follow in Meta’s Threads, but until they work on the app I cannot recommend it.
